name: Turbofy
description:
Turbofy® is the cloud workspace for apps built with AI agents. Connect Claude Code and build full-stack applications — schema, database, auth, file storage, flows, APIs, and UI — that run in the cloud from the first prompt. 

No servers to provision, no database migrations, no local setup, and no token markup: Turbofy charges for what you ship, not for what you built. Every app gets a real URL, shares one workspace and one data model with everything else you build, and is open to unlimited collaborators. Hosted in European data centres, GDPR-compliant by default.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Turbofy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Turbofy to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.turbofy.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Turbofy MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turbofy lists 29 MCP tools, including app_init, app_pull, app_push, block_type_check, block_type_open, data_add_many, data_create, data_delete, data_get, data_list, data_update, and file_upload.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Turbofy?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Turbofy in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Turbofy requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Turbofy is developed by GraphApi.io GmbH. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
